projects.title: Air-Quality Forecasting Course Project
bullets: Aligned public air-quality sensor time series as an assigned contribution to a supervised undergraduate course project.
Implemented a seasonal baseline for environmental time-series forecasting within the course project using Python, pandas and scikit-learn.

research.title: River-Level Forecasting Research Assistance
bullets: Implemented a seasonal baseline for forecasting public river-level measurements as a student assistant in supervised faculty research.
Aligned public river-level sensor time series for the forecasting work using Python, pandas and scikit-learn.

research.title: Rainfall Forecasting Research Assistance
bullets: Aligned public rainfall measurement time series and identified missing observations as a student assistant in supervised faculty research.
Implemented a seasonal baseline for forecasting public rainfall measurements using Python, pandas and scikit-learn.
